IAuthProvider.note: StoreTokenAsync stores the JSON blob {accessToken, refreshToken, clientId, clientSecret} (camelCase) to keychain. RefreshTokenAsync reads credentials from keychain, calls Zoho token endpoint, stores new access token, returns it. RenameTokenAsync moves credentials from old key to new key atomically. GetScopeEnhancementTokenAsync is used by AddScopesAsync (Zoho incremental authorization Step 1).

IOutputWriter.purpose: All output goes through this — commands NEVER write to Console directly. No success wrapper envelope.
methods: void WriteJson(object data)
void WriteRaw(string rawJson)
void WriteError(string message, string code, int exitCode)
IOutputWriter.note: WriteJson serializes data with SnakeCaseLower and writes to stdout. WriteRaw writes the raw string to stdout as-is (used by api call for Zoho response passthrough). WriteError writes the error envelope to stderr.

ITraceSession.note: Manages traces/sessions.json index. Mutex-protected for concurrent Seq assignment. Session statuses: active → closing → closed. Reopen sets closed back to active.

AccountEntry._removed: NeedsReauth removed in scope-incremental-auth refactor (was dead code)
AccountEntry.securityNote: No token, client_id, or client_secret fields. Credentials live exclusively in the OS keychain under zapi-cli:<name>:oauth.

properties.name: Body
properties.note: raw JSON string from Zoho server

properties: required string BaseUrl  (scheme+host+port, no path — for cross-product traceability)
string? Error  (non-null on transport failure only)

properties.name: ExportPath
properties.note: Absolute path to JSONL trace file

OAuthCredentials.type: internal sealed record (deserialized from keychain value)
OAuthCredentials.note: Stored as camelCase JSON blob in keychain. Never written to disk or any log.

MobileCallbackResult.description: Parsed parameters from the OAuth redirect callback for the Mobile OAuth flow
properties: string State  (CSRF state — must match sent state)
string? GtHash  (optional; sent as rt_hash in token exchange)
string? AccountsServer  (optional; per-user accounts base URL for DCL routing)
string? Location  (optional; DC location prefix e.g. 'us', 'eu' — used for DC auto-detection)

zohoCorpGuard.covers: zohocorp.com, zohocorp.eu, zohocorp.in, zohocorp.com.au, and all future datacenter TLDs
blockedEntryPoints: api request (before any HTTP request — check stored account email)

ACCOUNT_ALREADY_EXISTS.meaning: account login / mobile-login with duplicate name

ACCOUNT_RENAME_FAILED.meaning: Keychain rename partial failure (write OK but delete of old key failed)

NO_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT.meaning: No active account and --account not provided

API_ERROR.meaning: HTTP 4xx/5xx from Zoho API; response body still on stdout

ACCOUNT_DOMAIN_BLOCKED.meaning: Account email is a ZohoCorp domain

EMAIL_REQUIRED.meaning: User-info API returned no email; login aborted

HOST_NOT_ALLOWED.meaning: Outgoing URL host not in compile-time allowlist

STATE_MISMATCH.meaning: OAuth callback state parameter does not match sent state (CSRF guard)

LOGIN_TIMEOUT.meaning: 120-second browser auth window expired before receiving OAuth callback

DUPLICATE_IDENTIFIER.meaning: More than one of --name / --email / --Zuid provided (exactly one required)

SESSION_NOT_FOUND.meaning: Trace session name or UUID does not match any session

SESSION_AMBIGUOUS.meaning: Multiple trace sessions share the given name — use --id instead

EXPORT_PATH_NOT_SET.meaning: No --export-path on trace start and no default configured

ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND.meaning: api endpoints operation targets an id that does not exist

ENDPOINT_ALREADY_EXISTS.meaning: api endpoints add — specified id already exists

REGISTRY_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND.meaning: DEPRECATED alias of ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND — still present in ErrorCodes.cs for backward compatibility

SCOPE_ENHANCE_DENIED.meaning: User rejected scope enhancement consent or callback returned error

DCL_MISSING.meaning: Mobile OAuth token exchange response missing dc_locations field

RSA_DECRYPT_FAILURE.meaning: RSA decryption of gt_sec from Mobile OAuth callback failed

ENV_FILE_NOT_CONFIGURED.meaning: ZOHO_CLIENT_ID not set (account login); configure env-file or config set client-id

SCOPE_FILE_NOT_CONFIGURED.meaning: No scopes provided via --scope or configured scope-file
